page_title: LYO 0-0 TOU | Lyon v Toulouse 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' Malick Fofana (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
90' Frank Magri (Toulouse) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Millot who sees an offensive foul.
87' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Miha Zajc (Toulouse) for Denis Genreau.
85' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes was alert and made a comfortable save.
83' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
82' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
81' Corner kick. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is ready to send the ball into the box.
81' The ball is cleared after Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
80' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes the corner which is cleared.
79' Substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sael Kumbedi walks off.
79' It will be a substitution. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Rayan Cherki walks off.

78' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Lucas Perri guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
77' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Zakaria Aboukhlal and he is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joshua King departs the field of play to be replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
75' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
74' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
73' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' Great save! Malick Fofana (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Guillaume Restes.
71' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
70' It is time for a substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) is on for Said Benrahma.
68' A dangerous looking corner kick from Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is cleared to safety by the defence.
68' A pass lands at the feet of Joshua King (Toulouse) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
67' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
65' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Said Benrahma (Lyon).
63' Looks like Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
63' Said Benrahma (Lyon) serves up a nice cross, but Guillaume Restes punches the ball away.
62' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes it short.
61' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.

60' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!

58' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
58' Lyon take a short corner kick.
57' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
56' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
56' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
55' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

55' Said Benrahma (Lyon) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
54' Clinton Mata (Lyon) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
51' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
51' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Lyon have a corner.
49' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Lucas Perri.
48' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
47' A clumsy foul by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) and Benoit Millot blows his whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' The cross fools the defence and leaves Joshua King (Toulouse) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
45+3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

45+2' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+1' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
44' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
43' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
39' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
39' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
36' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
35' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Lyon! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Benoit Millot and both teams have no complaints.
33' Carles Martinez is stunned as referee Benoit Millot shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
33' Referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lyon. Let’s see what happens!
33' That looked a certain handball by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
33' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
32' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
32' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will take the corner.
30' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
27' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lucas Perri reads it well and gathers the ball.

27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Said Benrahma (Lyon) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
20' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
14' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Toulouse due to an offside in the build-up play.
13' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Toulouse players aren’t happy.
13' Goal! Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
12' Lucas Perri displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Joshua King (Toulouse) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

11' Joshua King (Toulouse) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Lucas Perri tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
5' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is caught offside!
2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lyon will kick-off.
Benoit Millot is introduced as the referee for today's match.
